description: A brief must use South African English spelling throughout its claims and audience note, never the US -ize/-or variants.

input.signal_summary: Turnkey DaaS platform go-live for a construction group's payroll cube took three weeks from kickoff, per the rollout log.

rubric.condition: The output contains zero occurrences of any of: organization, optimize, behavior, analyze.

rubric.criterion: At least one sourced proof point present
rubric.condition: The output field brief.proof_points is an array with at least 1 item.
Every object in brief.proof_points contains a non-empty source field naming where the claim came from.

notes: Anchored to prompt.md hard rule 4 (South African English).
